title: I made a Lemmings-inspired zombie rescue game with help from ChatGPT—would love some feedback
author: andytechuk
selftext:
I’ve just published my first game, Zombie Crossing.

You control a graveyard builder while zombies walk automatically towards whatever terrible fate you haven’t planned for. You build bridges, ramps, springs and walls to get them safely to a glowing tombstone.

I came up with the concept and worked through lots of testing and changes, with ChatGPT helping with the code. It’s been a fun learning process, and I’d love to hear how it feels to people who haven’t been involved in making it.

It plays in your browser:  
[https://partyon.itch.io/zombie-crossing](https://partyon.itch.io/zombie-crossing)

Mainly interested in whether the controls make sense and how the difficulty feels after the first few levels. Honest feedback and bug reports welcome!
